messages.content: My 8-year-old found something disturbing online. What should I do?

That's stressful — you're right to take it seriously. First, stay calm when talking with your child; your reaction will shape how they process it. Ask open questions to understand what they saw and how they're feeling. Then: enable parental controls on their devices, check browser history to understand the extent, and reassure them they won't be in trouble for telling you. Age-appropriate conversation about online safety is also a good follow-up.
